title: Claims denial spike versus coding mix
prompt: Insurance claim denials rose from 7% to 12% after a billing-system update. Determine why.
facts: The update went live on May 10.
A new specialty clinic opened May 1 and contributed 29% of May claims.
The specialty clinic denial rate is 24%; legacy-clinic denial rates remained 6-8%.
System validation errors remained flat before and after May 10.
Within the specialty clinic, missing prior-authorization codes explain 68% of denials.
